title: Service Requires swss will cause fast/warm reboot to fail
author: yxieca
body:
**Description**

Following 3 services were added with Requires swss flag:

root@sonic-host:/etc/systemd/system# grep swss *.service | grep Requires
iccpd.service:Requires=updategraph.service swss.service
mgmt-framework.service:Requires=swss.service
nat.service:Requires=updategraph.service swss.service

There are issues associated with this Rerquires flag:

During warm/fast reboot. These service will be shutdown when swss goes down. That adds extra time. And if service restart kicks in, they will drag up swss, causing fast/warm reboot to fail.

These services needs to be changed to be After swss service. And address dependency in swss service script following the existing examples.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. sudo fast-reboot -v or sudo warm-reboot -v and watch the progress

**Describe the results you received:**
The shutdown procedure could take several minutes. This is not a 100% reproduce.

**Describe the results you expected:**
shutdown happen quickly within 20-30 seconds before kexec kicks in.

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**
admin@str-7260cx3-acs-1:~$ sudo ./fast-reboot -v
OK
